page.text:
# Chirag Kathrani · Candidate for San Ramon, City Council District 2Educate, Engage, Encourage
I see so many bright people who want to contribute to better governance but are kept out of the system. I want to fundamentally change this by building a better governance framework, which is based on community first approach.
To achieve this vision, I founded and launched Open Governance News (OpGov.News) where we not only educate the community but with local civic-minded journalists, follow up and question the authorities.
With this approach of hyper-local focused news not only serving San Ramon but five cities in tri-vallley, we want to ensure community is informed, engaged and encouraged to run for office. Ensuring that no elections go unchallenged.
Lets connect, Please text me @ 925.435.7161 and we can setup a one to one coffee or Zoom meeting.
Share Your Voice
Support Chirag.$990$500$250$99$25Other
## What Matters to You Matters to Me
### Open Governance
Minimize the Closed door meetings to minimal so community is not kept out.
### Open Space Protection (Measure G)
Open space is important to preserved and protected.
### Small Business Ecosystem
Thriving local business ecosystem is source of future entrepreneurship
### Affordable by Design
Cheapest home starts in millions making it harder for young families to move in.
### Safe Neighbourhood
Engaged community becomes alert community
### Traffic Mitigation
Long term planning for traffic is essential for any development.
